title: Repository-scoped unattended Codex permissions
scope: Configure durable Codex permissions for unattended normal development only in the CarbTune Pro repository while retaining safeguards outside that repository.
objectives: Allow normal repository development and safe Git/GitHub workflow without repeated manual approval.
Keep dangerous, unrelated, privilege, credential, and machine-wide operations outside the unattended boundary.
constraints: Existing hook trust and supervision architecture remain unchanged.

acceptanceTests.expected: Installed Codex strictly loads the project configuration.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Strict doctor reported config.load ok, approval Never, restricted filesystem sandbox, enabled network sandbox, and complete sandbox provisioning.

acceptanceTests.expected: Repository reads, edits, validation, Git staging/commit, and normal push path avoid unresolved user approval waits.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Execpolicy allows only the protected wrapper. It staged and created implementation commit b8618ea4f4f41f30c7e239d321051816eb087a61; push is pinned to origin/main.

acceptanceTests.expected: The policy remains repository-scoped and blocks dangerous variants.
acceptanceTests.evidence: Wrapper rejected ../outside.txt and push --force; direct git add had no allow match; network destinations are allowlisted.

implementationNotes: Normal commands use workspace-write with approval_policy never so unsupported actions fail instead of waiting.
The protected wrapper permits only status, diff, bounded log, repository-relative add, one-line commit, origin fetch, origin/main fast-forward pull, and origin/main push.
Native Windows Codex rejected .git writes despite exact beta profile rules; auto-review reproduced a stalled probe. The wrapper and project-local allow rule are the narrowest verified fallback.
Two nested codex exec probes were interrupted after stalling before spawning a shell child; direct config, sandbox, execpolicy, wrapper, Git, and project validations completed independently.

validation.command: hook validation; npm run validate; strict doctor; execpolicy and wrapper tests; git diff checks
validation.summary: 28 hook assertions and all five CarbTune programs/152 workflow assertions passed; config/rules/wrapper passed; index.html unchanged. Doctor overall remains nonzero only for non-interactive TERM=dumb.
